# gg-svg

> SVG export backend for gg's recording system. A blank import registers the "svg" backend: draw with
> `recording.Recorder` (the gg drawing API), then play the recording back into `recording.NewBackend("svg")` and save
> it. Supports solid fills and strokes, linear and radial gradients with spread modes, fill/stroke/clip paths,
> transforms, stroke styles (width, cap, join, dashes), Save/Restore as SVG groups, text, and images embedded as PNG
> data URIs. Output is resolution-independent SVG. Go 1.25+, zero CGO. Pre-1.0: the API may change before v1.0.
